properties.description:
The patch in which a server holding many designs raises its open-file limit as it starts, warns when its designs could still run out of file handles, and /readyz says the files open against the limit. It carries #811 (a --registry-root server raises its soft RLIMIT_NOFILE to the hard limit and checks --registry-max-open x 76 files a design + 32 against it; /readyz gains the "open files: N of M allowed" line and the x-reflow2-open-files / x-reflow2-open-file-limit headers) and the cut itself (release/v0.93.1).

Pinned here: rel:v0931, the increment's ChangeEvents (found by diffing ids against the v0.93.0 tag's committed copy: 1, chg:a-registry-checks-its-file-handles-at-start-2026-10-28), and the cut's 8 drift acceptances. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
